capabilities_done: (1) Folio Resolver ports with Absent defaults: font(family, style), audio(audio_id), lut(lut, Option<content_digest>) (adjustment LUT references and clip-finishing StudioLutRef), placed_link(uri, content_digest); TypeStyleResolver forwards them; package externals resolve fonts (type styles, template control font_family / locked_font, motion template required_fonts), composition audio and LUTs through them, so they are resolved or typed losses (UnavailableExternal), never 'unresolved'

(2) linked placed sources: package LinkedFileResolver answers placed_link from the file next to the opened document (relative uri only, traversal / absolute / drive / backslash / NUL refused as unauthorized, canonical path must stay inside the document directory, sha256 in 1 MiB chunks bounded by max_bytes: resolved / modified / missing / unsupported); sessions opened from a path use it at open (loss notes) and in Session::externals

(3) optional CKC catalog asset_id on ClipSource::Media and StudioPlacedSource (serde default, not encoded when absent, earlier documents byte-identical); Folio is_catalog_asset_id = the kernel-bindings AssetId UUID grammar (test catalog_asset_id_contract compares both over a corpus incl. every single-byte mutation of a valid id); ExternalRef.asset_id carries it for relink by catalog record; every ClipSource::Media construction in the workspace gained asset_id: None (patterns ..), interop-psd placed-source construction asset_id: None
